english.title: Make misleading / false statement / promise / forecast to induce other to exercise / refrain from investment rights
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), made a

(A)_[statement]_
(B)_[promise]_
(C)_[forecast]_

which you knew to be misleading, false or deceptive in a material particular for the purpose of inducing or being reckless as to whether it may have induced another, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), to

(D)_[exercise]_
(E)_[refrain from exercising]_

rights conferred by a relevant investment
english.legislation: Contrary to section section 397(2)(b) and (8) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000.

english.notes:
(i) Section 397(4) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 provides that in proceedings brought against a defendant for this offence, it is a defence for this defendant to show that the statement, promise or forecast was made in conformity with
(a) price stabilising rules
(b) control of information rules
(c) The relevant provisions of Commission Regulation (EC) No 2273/2003 of 22nd December 2003 implementing Directive 2003/6/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards exemptions for buy-back programmes and stabilisation of financial instruments.
(ii) Section 397(9) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 provides that sections 397(1) and (2) do not apply unless:-
(a) the statement, promise or forecast is made in or from, or the facts are concealed in or from, the United Kingdom or arrangements are made in or from the United Kingdom for the statement, promise or forecast to be made or the facts to be concealed;
(b) the person on whom the inducement is intended to or may have effect is in the United Kingdom; or
(c) the agreement is or would be entered into or the rights are or would be exercised in the United Kingdom.
(iii) Section 397(9) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 provides that 'Relevant agreement' means an agreement:-
(a) the entering into or performance of which by either party constitutes an activity of a specified kind or one which falls within a specified class of activity; and (b) which relates to a relevant investment.
(iv) Section 401 of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 provides that proceedings for offences may be instituted in England and Wales only by the Authority or the Secretary of State or by or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Seven years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
